review-hub.enabled.description: Enable the Review Hub server and review interface for MCP proposals.

review-hub.watchDirectWrites.deprecationMessage: Review Hub now reviews MCP proposals only. Filesystem and Git diffs are ignored.
review-hub.watchDirectWrites.description: Deprecated. Direct file writes do not create Review Hub reviews.

review-hub.autoOpenDiff.description: Automatically open MCP changes as an inline red/green review in the native editor. Each hunk has Accept/Reject actions; Auto Save continues to save only the real file.

review-hub.ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore whitespace-only changes when computing hunks.

review-hub.maxFileSize.description: Skip hunk-level diffing for files larger than this many bytes (whole-file accept/reject only).

review-hub.excludeGlobs.description: Extra glob patterns excluded from review tracking and checkpoint snapshots. Built-in exclusions for version control, dependencies, caches and data artifacts always apply.

review-hub.maxSnapshotFiles.description: Hard cap on how many files a checkpoint snapshot will read. Keeps activation cheap on very large repositories.

review-hub.autoRegisterMcp.markdownDescription: Enable on **each machine** (this setting does not sync). Automatically detect supported AI agents on this machine (or the current remote host) and add Review Hub MCP to their user configuration. The first launch offers **Enable and Scan**; the **Scan and Register Detected Agents** command can also enable setup. Scans at startup, every minute and when installed extensions change. All supported agents use the MCP server bundled with this extension, updated in profile storage. Known Review Hub npm/legacy launchers migrate automatically; custom, disabled and remote entries are preserved and reported. Reconnect agents after an update. Turning this off stops registration and keeps configurations already added.

review-hub.requireReview.markdownDescription: Require human review through tool hooks for **Claude Code and OMP on Linux/macOS**. Requires Auto Register MCP and the agent checkbox. Blocks direct writes, shell/Python/eval, delegation, other MCP tools and agent Accept/Reject/checkpoints; use Hub proposal tools. Run builds/tests yourself in a terminal. Start a new agent session after installation/removal. Turning this off removes our policy on the next enabled scan; turning Auto Register MCP off or uninstalling the extension keeps installed hooks. Other agents show an unsupported warning. Hooks protect tool dispatch while loaded, not arbitrary plugins or disabled hooks. Claude hook commands require Node.js on PATH.

review-hub.claude.installInstructions.markdownDescription: With **Auto Register MCP** and **Agents: Claude Code** enabled, also install Review Hub editing instructions in the user-level `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (or `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/CLAUDE.md`). Only the marked Review Hub section is updated; existing content is preserved and backed up. Start a new Claude session to load it. Turning this off stops updates and keeps any installed instructions.

review-hub.agents.claudeCode.markdownDescription: Include **Claude Code** when **Review Hub: Auto Register MCP** is enabled. Only detected installations are configured. Existing entries are kept when unchecked.
